body:
Source: GitHub issues #787 (bug, P1-high, false-green) and #789 (bug, P1-high, false-green), both in packages/ticket-sync. Re-verified on main @ de8a130a. (a) lib/pull.mjs:151 `if (localTicket && remoteBlock) { railScopeGuard(...) }` — the rail-narrowing guard runs only when the remote adlc block EXISTS, while `buildTicket` (:58-68) treats BLOCK_KEYS (`scope, rails, edges, duration, category, budget`) as remote-owned and deletes every one when `block` is null. So deleting the whole block tracker-side strips rails and scope with exit 0, whereas a block that is PRESENT but omits `rails` correctly yields `rail-removed` violations and exit 2 (test/rails-guard-sync.test.mjs pins the empty-array case). Repro: local `{ rails:['test/auth/**'], scope:['src/auth/**'], duration:1 }`, remote body with no sentinels → exitCode 0, plan `take-remote`, ticket afterwards has no rails/scope/duration. docs/ticket-sync.md:90 says exit 2 covers `rail-narrowing without the flag`. (b) lib/validate.mjs:39-56 `validateObject` never checks unknown keys (comment at :53: `Unknown keys are tolerated (forward-compat)`), while lib/schema.mjs declares `additionalProperties: false` on the ticketSync block (:82), on `select` (:89) and elsewhere, and the generated schemas/adlc-config.schema.json publishes exactly that. lib/schema.mjs's header (:8) promises the two `can never diverge`. Repro: `.adlc/config.json` with `selct` and `statusLabel` misspelled → `doctor` prints `ok config-valid` and the selector silently drops `--label`, syncing every open issue.

CONTEXT FOR THE BUILDER. Package `packages/ticket-sync` is PRODUCER tier (it writes the ticket store): a clean same-model P5 is not sufficient; the parent handles the cross-model attestation ceremony — your job is to report `tier-check`'s exact `git-change:<base>:<digest>` line and which reviewer family reviewed the final commit. Layout: lib/pull.mjs (buildTicket, the reconcile loop :120-175), lib/rails-guard-sync.mjs (`railScopeGuard({localRails, incomingRails, localScope, incomingScope})` — `setOf(undefined)` is already an empty set), lib/validate.mjs (validateField/validateObject/validate + validateTicket/validateBlock/validateConfig/validateSyncState, CORE_SHARED_FIELDS agreement with @adlc/core), lib/schema.mjs (TICKET_DEF :31 `additionalProperties: false`, BLOCK_DEF :42 true, CONFIG_DEF :78 true with ticketSync :82 false and select :89 false, statusLabels :98 true, SYNC_STATE_DEF :108 true), lib/doctor.mjs (:36 `config-valid` row from validateConfig), schemas/adlc-config.schema.json (generated from schema.mjs — regenerate only if the generator says so; expected unchanged). Tests: `npm test -w packages/ticket-sync`; test/validate.test.mjs, test/rails-guard-sync.test.mjs, test/doctor.test.mjs, test/cli.test.mjs, test/validity.test.mjs are NOT rails and may change. IMPORTANT for (b): TICKET_DEF declares `additionalProperties: false`. Before enforcing it, run `validateTicket` over every shard in THIS repository's `.adlc/tickets/*.json` (read-only) and over the fields pull.mjs's buildTicket carries across (`completed`, extension fields). If real tickets carry keys TICKET_DEF does not list, STOP and report — do not loosen the schema and do not add fields to it; that is a finding the parent must decide.

NORMATIVE BEHAVIOUR.
1. The rail/scope guard runs whenever `localTicket` exists: `railScopeGuard({ localRails: localTicket.rails, incomingRails: remoteBlock?.rails, localScope: localTicket.scope, incomingScope: remoteBlock?.scope })`. An absent block is therefore the maximal narrowing (every local rail → `rail-removed`). When `remoteBlock` is null the error line is `<id>: remote issue carries no adlc block — <describeViolations> — rerun with --allow-rail-narrowing`; with `--allow-rail-narrowing` the pull proceeds exactly as today (block deleted, logged). A local ticket with no rails and no scope is unaffected by an absent block (no violations).
2. ONE exported pure function in lib/validate.mjs, `unknownKeys(obj, spec)`, returns the sorted list of own keys of `obj` not present in `spec.fields` WHEN `spec.additionalProperties === false`, else `[]`. `validateObject` is given the enclosing spec (definition or field spec) and appends `<path>.<key>: unknown key` (or `<key>: unknown key` at the root) for each; `additionalProperties: true` or absent stays tolerant. The stale comment at :53 is replaced by one that states the rule. The published JSON Schema and the runtime validator now agree; no change to schema.mjs definitions.
3. `doctor`'s `config-valid` row therefore fails on an unknown key and its detail names the key (`ticketSync.selct: unknown key`). `adlc ticket doctor` exit code for a failing config row is whatever it is today for a failing row (do not change the exit mapping).
4. Regression guards: a present block omitting `rails` still fails exactly as today; converged/keep-local decisions unchanged; `--force` conflict handling unchanged; `validateTicket` still accepts every ticket @adlc/core accepts on CORE_SHARED_FIELDS (the agreement test); every shard in this repository's store validates clean (see IMPORTANT above).
5. Documentation: `docs/ticket-sync.md` (:82 pull row and :90 exit codes) and by hand `apps/docs/content/docs/toolkit/ticket-sync.mdx` (:32): an absent remote adlc block is treated as rail removal and blocks without `--allow-rail-narrowing`; `doctor config-valid` rejects unknown keys where the schema forbids them. `packages/ticket-sync/README.md` the same two sentences if it documents either.

ACCEPTANCE CRITERIA.
- AC1 Fake provider, local ticket with rails+scope, remote body with no sentinels, base hash == local block → `exitCode 2`, error names `no adlc block` and the removed rail; with `--allow-rail-narrowing` → exit 0 and the ticket has no rails/scope (today's behaviour, now explicit). verify: `node --test packages/ticket-sync/test/pull-absent-block.test.mjs`
- AC2 Same setup with a local ticket that has NO rails and NO scope → exit 0, no error (absent block is not a narrowing of nothing). verify: `node --test packages/ticket-sync/test/pull-absent-block.test.mjs`
- AC3 `unknownKeys` table: `{a:1,b:2}` vs spec fields `{a}` with `additionalProperties:false` → `['b']`; with `true` → `[]`; with the flag absent → `[]`; input not mutated. verify: `node --test packages/ticket-sync/test/validate-unknown-keys.test.mjs`
- AC4 `validateConfig` on the issue's config (`selct`, `statusLabel`) returns errors naming both keys; a correct config returns `[]`; a config with an extra key under `statusLabels` (additionalProperties:true) returns `[]`. verify: `node --test packages/ticket-sync/test/validate-unknown-keys.test.mjs`
- AC5 `doctor` on a fixture with the typo config shows `config-valid` failing with the key named. verify: `node --test packages/ticket-sync/test/validate-unknown-keys.test.mjs`
- AC6 Every shard under this repository's `.adlc/tickets/*.json` passes `validateTicket` (read-only sweep executed in the test against the worktree's own store). verify: `node --test packages/ticket-sync/test/validate-unknown-keys.test.mjs`
- AC7 Existing suite green, including the core-agreement test. verify: `npm test -w packages/ticket-sync`
- AC8 Docs updated. verify: `grep -c "unknown key" docs/ticket-sync.md apps/docs/content/docs/toolkit/ticket-sync.mdx` (each >= 1) and `grep -c "no adlc block\|absent" docs/ticket-sync.md` (>= 1)
- AC9 Mutation gate green on the branch. verify: `node scripts/mutation-gate.mjs origin/main --max 12` exits 0 (also run `--max 80` once locally before review)
- AC10 `node packages/prosecute/bin/adlc-prosecute.mjs tier-check --author-provider anthropic --base origin/main` in the worktree after the final commit reports TRUST-ROOT and prints the `git-change:<base>:<digest>` string; quoted verbatim in the PR body. verify: the command above

OUT OF SCOPE: push.mjs, reassign.mjs, the GitHub provider, canonical hashing, #788 (LICENSE), #790+ if present, changing any schema definition.
title: ticket-sync: pull guards rail-stripping when the remote block is absent, and the validator honours additionalProperties:false
